title: Thakaa at AlexandriaX-2026: Who Gets the Final Say? Assigning Output Authority in Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation and Error Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28857v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report first-place systems for all four evaluated AlexandriaX-2026 settings: both English-to-dialect translation tracks, cross-dialect translation, and translation-error detection. In unconstrained translation, our minimum Bayes risk (MBR) selection restricts output authority: four local systems can supply the translation, while seven additional systems contribute only reference evidence. Candidate-constrained MBR beats the strongest complete candidate in all 13 dialects and gains 1.2554 macro spBLEU overall, reaching 33.4891. It also surpasses a retrospective oracle selecting the best whole candidate system per dialect. In the constrained track, country-routed LoRA adapters over a shared NileChat-3B-Base backbone incorporate the released Libyan and Sudanese supervision absent from the training and development splits, raising macro spBLEU from 29.5969 to 30.4233. translated_title: Thakaa团队在AlexandriaX-2026中的表现：谁拥有最终决定权？在方言阿拉伯语机器翻译与错误检测中分配输出权威
translated_abstract: 我们报告了在AlexandriaX-2026全部四个评测设置中均获得第一名的系统：两个英语到方言的翻译赛道、跨方言翻译以及翻译错误检测。在无约束翻译赛道中，我们的最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）选择机制对输出权威进行了限制：四个本地系统可以提供译文，而另外七个系统仅提供参考证据。候选约束的MBR在全部13种方言上都击败了最强的完整候选系统，宏观spBLEU整体提升1.2554，达到33.4891。它还超越了为每种方言回顾性选择最佳完整候选系统的事后oracle。在受限赛道中，基于共享NileChat-3B-Base骨干网络的国家路由LoRA适配器整合了训练集和开发集中缺失的已发布利比亚和苏丹监督数据，将宏观spBLEU从29.5969提升至30.4233。评测之后，在所有已发布的Alexandria数据上训练的单个适配器……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Thakaa团队通过最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）选择机制限制各系统的输出权威，并结合国家路由LoRA适配器整合利比亚和苏丹监督数据，在AlexandriaX-2026的全部四个方言阿拉伯语机器翻译与错误检测任务中均获得第一名。
en_tdlr: The Thakaa team won first place in all four AlexandriaX-2026 tasks by restricting output authority through MBR selection with candidate constraints and incorporating country-routed LoRA adapters with Libyan and Sudanese supervision data.
